1.explanation:
• lighthouse-core/gather/gather-runner.js  
  This module controls the start and stop of tracing and network-recording when you run Lighthouse. It uses driver.waitForLoad (with network-idle) and then tearDown, which currently doesn’t take into account the maxWaitForLoad override or the fact that in simulate mode there’s no enforced throttled network. It ends the trace as soon as the (unthrottled) network is idle, so late-loading resources and their layout shifts never make it into the trace.

• lighthouse-core/gather/driver.js  
  The driver.waitForLoad logic lives here. It implements the network-idle detection and applies the maxWaitForLoad timeout. In simulate mode, because the real page is not throttled, it almost instantly sees “network idle” and resolves, without respecting a customized longer wait. Fixing this file to apply the maxWaitForLoad flag even when throttlingMethod=simulate (or to wait for a minimum window after loadEventEnd) will allow late CLS events to be captured.

• lighthouse-core/computed/load-simulator.js  
  Once the short real trace is captured, this simulated load driver predicts performance metrics via Lantern. It uses the dependency-graph simulator, which terminates as soon as all CPU + network tasks are accounted for in the trace. Because the trace itself was too short, the simulator never sees late layout-shift events. Adjusting this artifact to either extend the simulation horizon (by honoring maxWaitForLoad) or to merge real post-load layout-shift entries will ensure that CLS is reported correctly under simulate throttling.
1.bug_scenario: When you run Lighthouse in CLI against the Venia bottoms page with throttlingMethod set to “simulate,” Lighthouse launches an un-throttled real page, records a very short trace (because network-idle is met immediately), and then uses the Lantern load simulator on that trace to predict performance. On this particular page, images and “add to cart” overlays keep loading and shifting the layout after Lighthouse’s trace recording stops. As a result, the Cumulative Layout Shift audit always reports 0 under simulate throttling, even though the live page continues to shift after the short simulated window (see screenshot).

2.explanation:
• gather/driver.js: implements waitForLoadEvent and waitForFcp and currently stops trace collection according to default idle/loadEvent times. Under simulate throttling these timeouts aren’t extended, so late network and layout‐shift events never get recorded.  
• gather/gather-runner.js: orchestrates the end of the gather phase (trace + network records). It uses driver.waitForLoadEvent and networkIdle thresholds to decide when to stop tracing. Those thresholds must respect maxWaitForLoad/maxWaitForFcp even under simulate.  
• computed/load-simulator.js: runs the offline Lantern simulation over the collected networkRecords & tasks and currently ends as soon as its internal queues drain. It needs to consider a minimum simulation window (e.g. maxWaitForLoad) to include late-loading resources and layout shifts.  
• cli-flags.js: defines and parses the maxWaitForLoad and maxWaitForFcp CLI flags, but in the simulate path these flags aren’t always honored.  
• run.js: wires up the CLI flags into the Lighthouse runner options. The simulate‐throttling code path currently ignores or overrides maxWaitForLoad, causing the runner to tear down before the extended wait interval.
2.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse is run with throttlingMethod set to “simulate,” the Lantern‐based load simulator applies the network and CPU slowdown to the trace of the page load and then decides that “all work is done” as soon as its internal simulation sees no more in‐flight requests or tasks. On dynamic PWA pages like Venia’s product listing, additional images and UI overlays can still load (and shift layout) after the simulator’s idle cutoff, but because the real trace ends at the usual network‐idle/loadEvent boundary and the simulator finishes early, those late shifts never make it into the Cumulative Layout Shift calculation. The result is a reported CLS of 0 even though the live page visibly shifts after the simulator has stopped.
